title: 31 ## PERSONS ARRESTED During 1970, 11,15,081 persons were apprehended for committing cognizable crimes under the Indian Penal Code as against 10,34,268 persons during 1969 indicating an increase of 7.8%. Table IX presents the number of persons arrested for cognizable crimes under the Indian Penal Code during 1969 and 1970 and the percentage variations during 1970 over 1969 in the States, Union Territories and important Cities.
